diagram_previews.alt: Triangle ABC with P the midpoint of AB, V the midpoint of BC and Q the midpoint of CA. M lies outside the triangle beyond A; line AB is extended (grey dashed) to E, and dashed blue segments ME and MF are parallel to BC and AB, with F on BC. Red lines PF and EV cross at N inside the triangle, and a green line passes through N, Q and M.
